description: Add optional Bedroom sleep and wake commands while preserving canonical WAIT and Z

replacements.old:
<SYNTAX WAIT = V-WAIT>
<SYNONYM WAIT Z>

<SYNTAX WAKE OBJECT (FIND ACTORBIT) (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-ALARM>
<SYNTAX WAKE UP OBJECT (FIND ACTORBIT) (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-ALARM>
<SYNONYM WAKE AWAKE SURPRISE STARTLE>
replacements.new:
<SYNTAX WAIT = V-WAIT>
<SYNONYM WAIT Z>

<SYNTAX SLEEP = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>
<SYNTAX SLEEP IN OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>
<SYNTAX SLEEP ON OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>
<SYNONYM SLEEP REST NAP DOZE>
<SYNTAX LIE DOWN = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>
<SYNTAX LIE ON OBJECT (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-HOUSE-SLEEP>

<SYNTAX WAKE = V-HOUSE-WAKE>
<SYNTAX WAKE UP = V-HOUSE-WAKE>
<SYNTAX WAKE OBJECT (FIND ACTORBIT) (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-ALARM>
<SYNTAX WAKE UP OBJECT (FIND ACTORBIT) (ON-GROUND IN-ROOM) = V-ALARM>
<SYNONYM WAKE AWAKE SURPRISE STARTLE>
